breakage_notes: Running 5 concurrent sandboxes on local Firecracker backend caused host CPU contention: boot-to-ready time increased from ~500ms median to ~1.2s median (2.4x). Memory pressure triggered OOM killer on host when 5x 2GB sandboxes + host processes exceeded 16GB RAM. Network policy 'off' worked correctly on all 5 (no cross-sandbox leakage). Snapshot store disk I/O became bottleneck during parallel rollbacks. Free trial single-sandbox limit prevented cloud concurrency test; local runtime allows multiple but requires host resources. Recommendation: implement sandbox pool with semaphore limiting concurrent boots to 2, and use larger host for production concurrency.
